scope: FastLLM generic ChunkGatedDeltaRulePrefill operator on Tesla V100; Qwen3.6 27B production shape, not end-to-end model throughput

method.note: Production service remained resident on the same GPU, so small cross-run differences are treated as load/clock noise. Only large, repeatable regressions are conclusive.

gates.FASTLLM_CUDA_SM70_FUSED_CHUNK_GDN_PREFIL: FP16 instantiation of existing fused H/O algorithm for exact SM70 64x128x128 shape
gates.FASTLLM_CUDA_CHUNK_GDN_ASYNC_GATHER: move per-chunk V gather from legacy stream 0 to cudaStreamPerThread
gates.FASTLLM_CUDA_CHUNK_GDN_FUSED_PREPROCESS: fuse decay scale generation, recurrent-state scaling, and K transpose/scale

conclusion.fused_h_o: Conclusive negative result: 12.58-12.80 ms versus 2.04-2.87 ms baseline, approximately 4.4x-6.2x slower.
conclusion.async_gather: No stable benefit; result direction changed across runs and remained within shared-GPU clock/load noise.
conclusion.fused_preprocess: No stable benefit; result direction changed across runs and remained within shared-GPU clock/load noise.
conclusion.persistent_scratch: Negative in the measured run; allocator mutex/vector scan is not a material part of this operator's steady-state cost.
conclusion.production_decision: Do not enable any experimental gate in the production profile. Preserve gates as default-off experiments with exact fallback and focused regression coverage.
